content.headline: Tokenisation Lab — see how AI reads your text
content.body: AI reads tokens, not full words. Hindi and Marathi text often costs 2–3x more tokens than English for the same sentence.
bullets: Try it: type an English circular, then a Hindi D.O., then a Marathi notice
Context window = the AI's working memory (bigger is not always better)
For huge PDFs: do not paste the whole file — use RAG or NotebookLM instead
